Name: Wave Link Control
Description: Control the volume and mute state of Elgato Wave Link 3 channels, inputs, outputs and mixes from the Stream Dock dials and keys.

com.raikerdev.wave_link.volumeknob.Name: Volume Knob
com.raikerdev.wave_link.volumeknob.Tooltip: Turn the dial to adjust the volume, press it to mute. Pick the channel, input, output or mix in the settings.

com.raikerdev.wave_link.mutetoggle.Name: Mute Toggle
com.raikerdev.wave_link.mutetoggle.Tooltip: Press to toggle mute. Pick the channel, input, output or mix in the settings.

com.raikerdev.wave_link.volumebutton.Name: Volume Button
com.raikerdev.wave_link.volumebutton.Tooltip: Raise, lower or set the volume from a key, with no dial needed.

com.raikerdev.wave_link.audioeffect.Name: Audio Effect
com.raikerdev.wave_link.audioeffect.Tooltip: Turn a VST/AU effect loaded on a Wave Link channel on or off.

com.raikerdev.wave_link.outputmix.Name: Output Mix
com.raikerdev.wave_link.outputmix.Tooltip: Change which mix an output listens to. Set an alternate mix and it flips between the two.
